newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine cash maize, soybeans, steady.
newsitem.headline: Argentine cash maize, soybeans, steady.

text.p: Argentine cash maize and soybeans were steady in slow cash market trade at the Buenos Aires Cereals Exchange, with inspiration lacking from both the Chicago market and local buyers, traders said.

Rains throughout crop areas further slowed business by stopping the maize and sunflower harvests. Prices paid to farmers for Buenos Aires maize were stuck at $111. May soybeans were steady at $288. April sunflower seed drifted down $2 to $226 in low volume, in a readjustment after last week's big rises. Bahia Blanca wheat perked up $2 to $142, with millers buying.
